question: Is the transfer charge that the Sia network documentation states (a bandwidth fee for upload and download) passed through to a Sia Storage free or paid plan, or is it covered by the plan price?
why: docs.sia.tech/store-your-data/about-renting.md lists bandwidth as a renter fee, and devs.sia.storage says pinned objects may be billed above free-tier limits, while the pricing page lists no per-GB transfer price and egress.metered is false in this record. Only a billing page or an invoice behind a sign-up would settle which one a plan buyer pays.
